tools.name: bubble-chair-blower-20261015.json
tools.description: Build an open-front spherical chair with adjustable diameter, opening, cushion thickness and colors. Use generated cushions or a supplied filling model, inspect the real geometry in Unity, then export a prefab with shell collision and a seat-placement anchor.
tools.command_template: Unity menu: Tools > Unity Unicorn > Bubble Chair Blower
requirements: Unity 2022.3 Built-in Render Pipeline; install the editor script and prismatic-glass-20261015.shader.
limitations: Editor generator, not a runtime blowing interaction.
Add and test VRCStation separately. Original reference-chair matching remains open.
